subject: Two-layer DKC soundtrack revision and lively performance direction
question: How should the DKC profile become a revision guide?
decision: Provide a detailed complete outline of every melody by theme, instruments and tone, followed by application of the master-audit cast. Develop a livelier interpretation with mild artistic liberties, selective swing and intentional irregularity rather than perfectly quantized performance; research Cuban/Afropop influences and integrate specific performance notes. This commission advances the written guide; original in-game instrument authority remains primary and rendered acceptance is separate.
